newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies seven bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies seven bond issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Tuesday it qualified seven issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--San Juan County School District #22, N.M., $10 million of GO school building bonds.
--Windber Area School District, Pa., $4 million and $4.6 million of GO bonds.
--Grand Prairie, Texas, $3.2 million of certificates of obligation.
--Grand Prairie, Texas, $2.4 million of GO bonds.
--Kenosha County, Wis., $3.9 million of GO promissory notes.
--Kenosha County, Wis., $29 million of GO detention center notes.
